title: Pressure = Force ÷ Area
guideExplore: Change force and contact area — read pressure P = F ÷ A on the stage.
guideNail: Nail tip: tiny area → very high pressure.
guideShoe: Wide shoe: large area → low pressure for the same force.
conditionsHint: Same force on smaller area gives higher pressure.
learnMore: Pressure tells how concentrated a force is. Spread the same force over more area and pressure drops.
quizQuestion: For the same force, smaller area means…
